title: Pastime Fishing Adventures
specs: Fish species include halibut, salmon, sturgeon, lingcod, rockfish, cod, cabezon, sea bass, albacore tuna, and crab
Trips operate from Newport, Depoe Bay, Lincoln City, and other Oregon coastal ports
Guests must purchase their own fishing licenses from Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife
Fishing license must be on mobile app to tag salmon
Not recommended for guests with circulatory problems, high blood pressure, heart conditions, pregnancy, weak bones, knees, back or ankle problems
Minimum 2 persons, maximum 6 persons per trip
includes: All bait and tackle needed to catch fish
blurb: Guests fish for various species in Oregon's rivers and coastal waters, including halibut, salmon, sturgeon, lingcod, and bottom fish. Trips range from half-day to full-day charters with all bait and tackle provided. Guests must bring their own food, drinks, and fishing licenses.
extraNote: $100 deposit required at booking · Cancellations must be made at least three weeks in advance for deposit refund · Deposits forfeited can be applied to another trip if booked within two months · Full refund if Pastime cancels or trip cancelled due to unsafe weather and cannot reschedule within one year · No refunds for guests returning due to sea sickness · 3.2% fee added for credit card payments; $50 fee for bounced checks · Newport South Marina for Newport trips; other ports include Depoe Bay and Lincoln City marinas · Prime fishing season is May through September
